welcome.title: Before you begin
welcome.description1: This app is a presentation client for the ACR-Platform reasoner. All reasoning happens server-side.
welcome.description2: Synthetic data only. Do not enter live, coded or pseudonymised patient information.
welcome.description3: No intentional clinical data at rest. Entries exist in memory for one assessment only.

assessment.clinicalTransparency: Clinical transparency: outputs are decision support only, generated by a validated rule base. Clinical judgement remains with the clinician.

receptors.ki67Hint: 0–100. Luminal A < 14, Luminal B ≥ 14. Guidance only — classification is performed by the reasoner.
receptors.sessionIdHint: Fresh UUIDv4 per assessment. Never entered, never reused, never persisted.

tumour.stageHint: Values populated from the frozen API-contract enum — no overlapping aliases.
tumour.ageHint: 18–120, whole years. Age is the only demographic field the reasoner consumes.

biomarkers.ca153Hint: Reference threshold 35.0 — evaluation is performed server-side.
biomarkers.ceaHint: Reference threshold 5.0 — evaluation is performed server-side.
biomarkers.surgeryDateHint: Future dates are permitted and submitted unchanged: the B3 guard is the reasoner's responsibility and must remain testable.

review.bayesianHint: Sets a request field only. No calculation occurs on the device.
review.attestationHint: Reasoner v2.2.1 · OPENLLET_SWRL · ontology hash matches the accepted baseline manifest.
review.submitBlocked: Submission is blocked unless attestation is VERIFIED.

result.title: Assessment result
result.subtitle: Server-side reasoning · synthetic profile
result.confidenceHint: Moderate confidence. Full precision shown as a visible integrity check.
result.rulesFiredHint: Only rules that actually fired are listed.
result.recommendationsHint: Text is returned by the reasoner and rendered unchanged.
result.retentionHint: This result is held in memory only. Leaving this screen clears the assessment. Nothing is written to device storage.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Build and baseline identity
about.dataHandlingText: No intentional clinical data at rest. No analytics. Crash reporting disabled for wave one. Over-the-air updates disabled — every change requires a new reviewed build.

failClosed.title: Service unavailable
failClosed.subtitle: Baseline verification failed
failClosed.heading: Assessment blocked
failClosed.message: The service could not verify that the connected reasoner matches the accepted baseline. No assessment can be submitted until verification succeeds.
failClosed.expectedValuesHint: Expected values come from the accepted baseline manifest; they are never reported as observations.
failClosed.sameTreatment: Same treatment for MISMATCH. Retry re-runs verification only — it never resubmits an assessment.

provenance.acrNativeDesc: Rule authored and promoted within the ACR rule base
provenance.openlletDesc: Rule evaluated and verified by the Openllet reasoner

errors.schemaInvalid: Invalid input format. Please check your entries.
errors.authRequired: Session expired. Please restart the app and redeem your invite code.
errors.attestationMismatch: The connected reasoner does not match the accepted baseline. Assessment blocked.
errors.attestationUnavailable: The reasoner baseline could not be verified. Please retry.
errors.serviceUnavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.indeterminate: The assessment outcome is uncertain. Do not retry automatically — contact support.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
errors.networkError: Network connection failed. Please check your connection and try again.
